narrative.overview: SkinLedger should read like the printed report of a high-end Seoul skincare laboratory: warm ivory paper, stone panels, one deep sage accent, a refined serif for the things you read and a quiet sans for the things you operate. It is clinical without being cold, premium without selling anything. The interface never performs wellness; it presents a measurement, a band and an honest answer with the calm of a lab report.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory page, stone surfaces, ink text, one deep sage accent.
Fraunces display serif for headings; Inter for UI and body; tabular figures for every number.
Sand band, sage line, hairline grid: the noise band is the signature graphic.
12–16px card radii, full-pill chips and segmented control, 1px warm hairlines, no decorative shadow.
Generous 8/12/16/24/32/48 spacing; 1120px maximum line length with real margins.
Dark mode is warm charcoal (#1C1A17), never black.

rules.name: The One Judgement Rule
rules.body: Sage, amber, red and warm stone mean a verdict state. Sand and rose never do.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The page is warm ivory. Stone panels group content; tinted surfaces appear only when a state changes.

rules.name: The No Decorative Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients are not used as decoration. A single subtle tonal wash may sit inside the noise-band visual, where it represents the band.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is for reading and for the answer; sans is for operating and for numbers. Never use the serif for form fields, buttons or data cells.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every score, band, date and count uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadow on buttons, chips, inputs, table rows or ordinary cards. The hero visual and the verdict summary are the only lifted surfaces.

dos: Do keep the footer disclaimer verbatim on every page and the exact disclaimer inside the verdict card.
Do keep REAL / SIMULATED / SAMPLE visible on every data point.
Do keep the noise-band visual and the tabular numbers as the product's signature.
Do use Fraunces for reading and Inter for operating and for every number.
Do use sand and rose as atmosphere only; never as a verdict signal.
Do keep 44px targets, 2px sage focus rings and 4.5:1 text contrast on ivory and dark.
Do open the layout to two and three columns on tablet and laptop.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients, glassmorphism, glow, coloured shadows or emoji.
Don't use stock photos, faces, testimonials, press logos or product brands.
Don't use luxury superlatives (revolutionary, luxurious, miracle).
Don't introduce a second accent colour; sage is the only action and Keep colour.
Don't use sand or rose to say Keep, Worse or No change.
Don't use the serif for buttons, inputs or data cells.
Don't add a webfont beyond the two self-hosted OFL families; no external font origins on app pages (the capture page keeps its existing Camera Kit exception).
Don't show or chart ui_score; the raw score is the only approved number.
